name: known-gap-role-shape-conflicts
reason: ScorePreferenceFit routes work_type preferences at signals.WorkType, culture_signals, and core_competencies. Two consequences on this JD, and #53's widening did not close either. (1) The 'frontend' negative is typed work_type. work_type is a closed enum of remote/hybrid/onsite/unknown, so the enum itself can never hold it; the role shape lives in required_skills (React, TypeScript, CSS) and in screening_summary.other_flags ('frontend-majority role, roughly 80% of time in the client codebase'), and the work_type branch reads neither. This fixture also predates core_competencies and carries none, which is where a competency-worded extraction would have put it. This is Group C of notes/hard-exclude-preference-audit.md, which called 'pure frontend' miscategorized for the same reason. (2) 'on-call heavy' and 'mandatory overtime' are the persona's words; the JD's words are '24/7 on-call rotation' and 'extended hours'. containsPhrase requires a contiguous whole-word run, so neither matches -- the same morphological miss already documented for REST vs RESTful APIs in matchesAny. Because an unmatched negative preference EARNS its weight, all three do not merely fail to appear as conflicts: they are scored as if the JD successfully avoided something the JD in fact advertises.
description: The three conflicts database/sample/README.md says this fixture surfaces. Asserted separately from weak-match.json so that the gaps-vs-conflicts separation stays enforced while the matching defect stays visible.
